description:
One convective cell of the storm designer (SPEC.md 10.2; the ``/replay`` cell table).

Positions and velocities are in :attr:`StormDesign.crs`, the city's metric CRS.
``birth_min`` is minutes from the bundle's ``t0`` and may be negative, which means the
cell was already alive when the replay window opened.

birth_min.description: Minutes from t0 at which the cell is born.
birth_min.title: Birth Min

lifetime_min.description: Minutes from birth to death; the sine envelope spans exactly this.
lifetime_min.title: Lifetime Min

peak_mm_h.description: Peak rain rate at the cell centre before intensity_scale is applied.
peak_mm_h.title: Peak Mm H

sigma_m.description: Gaussian radius in metres (2-6 km in the demo storm).
sigma_m.title: Sigma M

start_x_m.description: Cell centre at birth, easting in the design CRS.
start_x_m.title: Start X M

start_y_m.description: Cell centre at birth, northing in the design CRS.
start_y_m.title: Start Y M

title: StormCellSpec
